items.requirement: An isoSPI (isolated SPI) transceiver pair or a digital isolator between the ADBMS1818ASWAZ-RL and the measurement coprocessor's SPI1, rated 85 V DC working or more (V189). Answered under Raised by P1: V289: A digital isolator on direct SPI, rated 85 V DC working or more (V189). Its current is for research (owner, 2026-10-01). Its pack side runs from an always-on supply referenced to the pack negative, not from the ADBMS1818's regulator, which is off while the monitor sleeps; the same supply gives the ADBMS1818 an external VREG, and V+ of 16 V or more for packs under 16 V. That supply is a function of R9 (owner, 2026-10-02)
